rationale: Supports clean mapping of tree data to target paths.
Encapsulates semantic navigation within the strategy layer.
Explicitly uses the 'type' and 'path' metadata for efficient discovery.
Aligns with the 'data-first' principle of using GitHub's provided tree structure.
Provides flexibility for various task naming conventions.
Ensures the 'Never download full level' guardrail is strictly enforced by targeting only dir nodes.
Pragmatic use of available API metadata avoids unnecessary complex parsing (regex).
